behaviors.description: Persist descriptor-supplied environment overrides for one app.
behaviors.preconditions: Two app IDs with an independent control override and two descriptor payloads.
behaviors.expected: Public override output shows exactly the new empty/nonempty values on the selected app while control app is unchanged.

mappings.rationale: Each descriptor replaces the selected app's values while an unrelated app retains its control value.

surface_assertions.rationale: Exact descriptor values persist through public override inspection with app isolation.
